rows.name: LIZARD
rows.description: Two white towers, each 61 ft. high, W. by N. & E. by S., 223 ft. apart, on the Lizard Cliff. In one lead clear of the Manacles. A signal and telegraph station on Beast Point, about ¾ of a mile to E. Fog-trumpet, 1 blast every 5 minutes

rows.name: WOLF ROCK
rows.description: A noble granite tower. Flashes red and white alternately. Fog Bell, 3 strokes ev. ½ min.

rows.name: Penzance Tide Light
rows.character: A fixed red or br. light, while 15 ft. inside; green while less
rows.description: On the S. pier-head. Shows red to E. by S. ½ S. to S. by W. ¼ W. The remainder a bright light. By day, a ball while 15 feet

rows.name: LONGSHIPS
rows.description: New tower, 1873. White lt. seaward, from N.N.E. ½ E., or ½ mile W. of Brisons Rocks, to S. by E., or ¾ mile W. of Runnelstone; red in-shore of these bearings. Fog-bell 2 strokes ev. ½ minute

rows.name: SEVEN STONES LT.-VES.
rows.description: On E. side of rocks, in 40 fms.; two red balls; Warning-gun; powerful Fog-horn ev. 10 secs. or Gong. To be altered in summer of 1879 to rev. lt., showing 3 flashes once in ev. min.

rows.name: SCILLY
rows.character: One bright revol. light every minute
rows.description: A white tower, 74 feet high, on the summit of St. Agnes' Island; obscured by islands from N. by E. to East

rows.name: BISHOP ROCK
rows.description: On the S.W. rock. A noble stone tower, 147 feet high. Invisible to eastward between N.E. by E. and E. by S. ½ S. Bell ev. 10 secs.

rows.name: St. Ives Tide Light
rows.description: On the pier head. Lighted from Sept. 1 to April 30. Also a red light on end of outer wooden pier

rows.name: Hayle Tide Lights
rows.character: 1. Two fixed bright lts. 2. One fixed red light
rows.description: 1. On W. side of entr.; in one S.S.W. ½ W., 297 ft. apart, while 12 ft. water 2. On jetty of Lelant Quays

rows.name: GODREVY
rows.character: One br. flash. lt., 10 secs. Lower red light
rows.description: On the island. A bell in fogs. Lower red lt. to N.W. over the Stones Rocks, between N.W. and N. by W.

rows.name: Padstow
rows.description: A red or green light on quay head

rows.name: TREVOSE HEAD
rows.description: The lower light is 50 feet to seaward of the upper

rows.name: HARTLAND POINT
rows.description: New tower, showing at intervals of 30 secs. two bright and one red flash. Fog-Horn 5 secs. in every 2 min.

rows.name: LUNDY ISLAND
rows.character: Upper lt., rev. ev. 2 m. Lower fixed light
rows.description: In one tower, 96 ft. high. Low light visible to W. between N.N.W. and W.S.W. Rocket every 10 min. in fogs

rows.name: Bideford
rows.description: On Braunton Sands, North side of entrance. In one, S.E. ½ S., lead over bar; from half flood to half ebb

rows.name: BULL POINT
rows.description: Lt.-ho. to be completed during the summer of 1879, and will show triple flash. lt. ev. ½ min. A lower red fix. lt. will be shown over Morte Stone. Fog-trumpet, to give 3 blasts once every 2 minutes

rows.name: Ilfracombe
rows.description: One red light on Lantern Hill

rows.name: Watchet Breakwater
rows.description: Tide light fixed, 8 ft. flood to 10 ft. ebb

rows.name: Burnham, or Bridgewater
rows.character: Up. lt. intermit. 4 min. Lower light fixed
rows.description: In one, E. by S. ½ S., 1,500 ft. apart. Low lt. bright, visible westward from W. by N. to N.W. by W. ¾ W.; a red lt. from low tower shows over the bar from W. by N. to W. ½ N.; and a red lt. up the river from S. by W. to S. by W. ½ W.
